generator: lake exe spec-vectors (NewenSpec.Thermostat.berendsenFloat, noseHooverFloat; SplitMix64, fixed seed)
encoding: every float is the hex string of its IEEE 754 binary64 bits (f64::to_bits, Float.toBits); nhc is a plain integer
layout_berendsen: ekin, dof, temperature, tau, dt, scale
layout_nose_hoover: ekin, dof, temperature, tau, dt, nhc, zeta_in[0..nhc), zeta_out[0..nhc), scale; consecutive rows of one run carry zeta_out into zeta_in
